name: Puget Mesh

mqtt.advice: OK to MQTT on. Uplink on, downlink off so internet traffic doesn't flood LongFast.

notes: Fixed nodes: usually CLIENT or CLIENT_MUTE. Never ROUTER or REPEATER without talking to the group.
They publish community channels (PS-Mesh!, PS-MQTT!) with keys on their config page; type names and keys by hand, they are case-sensitive.
Their config page is dated 2025-11-27. A ShortFast (slot 68) trial ran in May 2025.
